stem: A community paediatrics trainee has several concerns from different contacts about a child, and no single issue clearly reaches significant risk on its own; which feature of the Child Wellbeing Unit makes a call still useful?

options.text: It is intended only for imminent Risk of Significant Harm notifications
It can accept concerns that do not meet significant risk and can consider accumulative risk of harm
It provides forensic medical assessment for suspected maltreatment
It is available any day and any time through 132 111
It should be used only after a full investigation has clarified the exact mechanism of harm

explanation: Child Wellbeing Unit access is useful here because it can accept concerns that do not meet significant risk and can consider accumulative risk of harm.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because imminent Risk of Significant Harm notifications are linked to the Child Protection Helpline, not the Child Wellbeing Unit
optionExplanations.B: Correct because the Child Wellbeing Unit can take concerns below the significant-risk threshold and assess the cumulative pattern of harm
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because forensic medical assessment is a function of the Child Protection Unit, not the Child Wellbeing Unit
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because 132 111 and 24-hour access refer to the Child Protection Helpline, whereas the Child Wellbeing Unit is office-hours only
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because the Child Wellbeing Unit can be contacted for concerning situations without a full investigation having already been completed

sourceRefs: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
